title: Descent data for affine morphisms over an fpqc covering are effective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For an fpqc covering {X_i -> S} and a descent datum (V_i/X_i, phi_ij) with each V_i -> X_i affine, the lemma asserts effectivity of the datum (statement lines 9364-9373). The proof is a complete construction: reducibility of the property reduces to a single faithfully flat ring map R -> A, affineness writes V = Spec(B), the descent isomorphism is transported to an isomorphism of A tensor A-algebras, the cocycle condition becomes the commutativity of the usual triple-tensor diagram, and inverting the arrows turns the datum into a descent datum for modules with respect to R -> A; the module descent proposition then yields the R-module C = Ker(B -> A tensor_R B) with A tensor_R C = B compatibly with descent data, the algebra structure on C is obtained because phi is an algebra homomorphism, and applying Spec produces the descended scheme U (proof lines 9375-9420). The level is H3: every step, including the verification that the descended module is an algebra, is written out.
